cast_sequence: hn=sqrt(fsum(float64(h0_j)*float64(h0_j))); offset_j=float32(float64(hn*serialized_w_j)); hidden_j=float32(h0_j+offset_j); every call starts at original prompt; no sign/strength/renormalization/projection
interpretation: ONE exposed f04/v1 situation/four existing layouts; frozen original-C transfer DEVELOPMENT. coverage_policy: eligibility: original eligible baseline A with requested B, or B with requested A; achieved: eligible original edit strictly accepted with requested full argmax; also report all actual argmax flips separately. Missing coverage is unresolved, never a new acceptance gate or permission for baseline search.
